name: comp-398

frames.best_why: Shows the whole round photo and its white count bubble with no cursor crossing them.

tagline: Round profile photo wearing a white count bubble on its top corner.
summary: A circular profile photo with a small white badge counting unread messages on its upper right, centred above a name and a one-line message total.
appearance: A circular portrait roughly 56px wide sits centred on a near-black stage, with a white pill bubble holding a dark 6 overlapping its top-right edge. Below it a bold white name and a dimmer grey message line are stacked and centred.
behaviour: Static: the photo, badge and caption never move or respond. Only the recording cursor drifts across the empty space around them.
demo_content: Kelly King and the line 6 unread messages, over a woman's portrait in the avatar.
search_phrases: profile picture with unread message count
number bubble on profile photo corner
small count chip on a face
use_when: Showing who a message came from together with how much is waiting from them.
avoid_when: A live count: the number and photo are fixed inside the file, so they need wiring to real data.
customise: The count, portrait URL and fallback initials are written inside the file, so adopting it means editing them. The bubble's offset and minimum width live in its class list.
weight_why: A single image and a text badge; no script, loop or animation.

a11y.note: The portrait carries alt text, but the number is bare text with nothing explaining it to screen readers.

issues: The unread count is fixed at 6 in the markup instead of coming from data.
polish_why: Clean, ordinary avatar and badge with tidy overlap; nothing distinctive beyond placement.
